links.outcome: Baseline readability of online orthopaedic oncology patient education materials
links.effect: Baseline FKGL 8.7 ± 1.5 (eighth to ninth grade), GFI 10.5 ± 1.9, FRE 53.9 ± 8.2; above recommended sixth-grade level.
links.quote: Baseline FKGL (8.7 ± 1.5) was between the eighth-grade and ninth-grade reading level, and GFI (10.5 ± 1.9) was slightly higher.

links.outcome: Readability, accuracy and comprehension after LLM rewriting of materials to sixth-grade level
links.effect: All LLMs significantly improved readability (P < 0.001); Gemini F1 0.986 (range 0.765-0.986) with 100% comprehension; Meta AI accuracy and comprehension compromised below sixth grade.
links.quote: All LLMs significantly improved readability (P < 0.001), and ChatGPT-4o, DeepSeek AI, and Google Gemini conversion produced the most readable outputs.
